topic: Screens, dry eyes & eye strain: complete guide for office workers and students

youtube.title: Screens, dry eyes & eye strain: complete guide | LenzKare
youtube.description:
Screens, dry eyes and eye strain: a complete guide for office workers and students. 💻
திரை, கண் வறட்சி, கண் சோர்வு: முழு வழிகாட்டி.

• Digital eye strain: tired eyes, burning, blur, headache, plus neck and shoulder pain.
• Close work keeps the focusing muscle tight for hours, and we blink much less while staring at a screen.
• The tear film has 3 layers (oil, water, mucus); when it breaks up, eyes feel gritty or even watery.
• AC and fans on the face, late nights, contact lenses and smoke make it worse.
• Rules: 20-20-20, blink fully, screen at arm's length with the top at eye level, windows to the side, brightness matched to the room.
• Uncorrected power makes strain worse, so get an eye test and use the right glasses for screen distance.
• Painful red eye, light sensitivity or sudden blur: see an eye specialist urgently.
